ko.title: [마케팅 101 #9] 최고의 제품이 이기는 게 아니다. 실제로 구할 수 있는 것이 이긴다.

segments.src: > "Place" isn't about where a product sits. It's about how many steps stand between wanting it and holding it — and who does the work of removing them.
segments.tr: > "유통(Place)"은 제품이 어디에 있는지가 아니다. 그것을 원하는 것과 손에 들게 되는 사이에 몇 단계가 있고, 누가 그 단계를 제거하는 일을 하는지에 관한 것이다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Of marketing's four Ps — product, price, promotion, place — **place** is the least glamorous and quietly the most decisive.
segments.tr: 마케팅의 4P — 제품, 가격, 프로모션, 유통 — 중에서 **유통**은 가장 화려하지 않으면서도 조용히 가장 결정적이다.

segments.src: It's shorthand for *distribution*: the path a product travels from whoever made it to whoever uses it.
segments.tr: 이는 *유통*을 줄여 말한 것이다: 제품이 만든 사람에서 사용하는 사람까지 여행하는 경로.

segments.src: Two questions define that path.
segments.tr: 두 가지 질문이 그 경로를 정의한다.

segments.src: How many hops?**
segments.tr: 몇 단계의 중간 거래처를 거치는가?**

segments.src: A **direct channel** goes maker → customer: a farmers market stand, a brand's own website, a factory outlet.
segments.tr: **직접 채널**은 제조자 → 고객으로 간다: 농산물 시장 부스, 브랜드 자체 웹사이트, 공장 직판장.

segments.src: An **indirect channel** adds **intermediaries**: manufacturer → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you.
segments.tr: **간접 채널**은 **중간 거래처**를 추가한다: 제조업체 → 도매업체/유통업체 → 소매업체 → 당신.

segments.src: Each hop takes a slice of margin.
segments.tr: 각 단계마다 마진의 일부를 빼앗긴다.

segments.src: Each hop also does real work.
segments.tr: 각 단계마다 실질적인 일도 한다.

segments.src: That's the part people get wrong.
segments.tr: 그것이 사람들이 잘못 이해하는 부분이다.

segments.src: The common complaint is that middlemen are markup for nothing.
segments.tr: 일반적인 불평은 중간 거래처가 아무 일도 안 하고 마진만 붙인다는 것이다.

segments.src: But distribution functions can be *shifted*, not *eliminated*.
segments.tr: 하지만 유통 기능은 *제거될 수* 없고 *이전될* 수만 있다.

segments.src: Somebody has to:
segments.tr: 누군가는 다음을 해야 한다:

segments.src: - **Break bulk** — turn a truckload into a shelf's worth
segments.tr: - **대량 분할** — 트럭 한 대분을 선반 한 칸분으로 나누기

segments.src: - **Carry inventory** and absorb the risk that it doesn't sell
segments.tr: - **재고 보유** 및 팔리지 않을 위험 부담

segments.src: - **Extend credit** so a small store can stock before it sells
segments.tr: - **외상 제공** 소규모 가게가 판매하기 전에 입고할 수 있도록

segments.src: - **Assemble assortment** so you don't visit 40 brand websites for one shopping trip
segments.tr: - **상품 조합** 한 번의 쇼핑을 위해 40개의 브랜드 웹사이트를 방문하지 않도록

segments.src: - **Handle returns**, damage, and customer questions
segments.tr: - **반품 처리**, 손상, 고객 문의

segments.src: Cut the distributor and you inherit the warehouse, the trucks, the credit risk, and the returns desk.
segments.tr: 유통업체를 제거하면 당신이 창고, 트럭, 신용 위험, 반품 처리 부서를 물려받는다.

segments.src: Sometimes that's worth it.
segments.tr: 때로는 그럴 가치가 있다.

segments.src: It's never free.
segments.tr: 하지만 결코 자유로운 것은 아니다.

segments.src: How widely?**
segments.tr: 얼마나 광범위하게?**

segments.src: This is **distribution intensity**, and it has three settings:
segments.tr: 이것을 **유통 집약도**라 하며, 세 가지 설정이 있다:

segments.src: - **Intensive** — everywhere physically possible. Soda, gum, phone chargers, sunscreen. Nobody drives across town for a Coke; if it isn't there, the sale goes to whatever *is*.
segments.tr: - **집약적(Intensive)** — 물리적으로 가능한 모든 곳. 소다, 껌, 휴대폰 충전기, 자외선 차단제. 코크 한 잔을 위해 마을을 가로질러 운전하는 사람은 없다; 그곳에 없으면 판매는 *있는* 것으로 간다.

segments.src: - **Selective** — a curated set of partners. Appliances, mid-tier cosmetics, running shoes. Enough coverage to be findable, few enough to keep service quality up.
segments.tr: - **선택적(Selective)** — 엄선된 파트너 집합. 가전제품, 중상급 화장품, 러닝화. 찾을 수 있을 정도의 충분한 커버리지이면서도 서비스 품질을 유지할 수 있을 정도로 적다.

segments.src: - **Exclusive** — one partner per territory. Luxury watches, car dealerships, high-end audio. Scarcity and service are part of the product.
segments.tr: - **독점적(Exclusive)** — 지역당 한 파트너. 럭셔리 시계, 자동차 판매점, 고급 오디오. 희소성과 서비스가 제품의 일부다.

segments.src: The right setting follows how people shop.
segments.tr: 올바른 설정은 사람들이 어떻게 쇼핑하는지에 따른다.

segments.src: The less someone is willing to search, the more intensive you must be.
segments.tr: 누군가가 찾으려는 의욕이 적을수록, 당신은 더 집약적이어야 한다.

segments.src: **Multichannel vs.
segments.tr: **다중채널(Multichannel) vs.

segments.src: omnichannel.** These get used interchangeably and shouldn't be.
segments.tr: 옴니채널(Omnichannel).** 이 둘은 상호 교환적으로 사용되곤 하는데 그래서는 안 된다.

segments.src: *Multichannel* means you sell in several places, each running as its own silo — the website has no idea what the store has.
segments.tr: *다중채널*은 여러 곳에서 판매하되, 각각이 독립적인 사일로로 운영되는 것이다 — 웹사이트는 매장에 무엇이 있는지 모른다.

segments.src: *Omnichannel* means those channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history, so the shopper experiences one brand instead of three departments.
segments.tr: *옴니채널*은 그 채널들이 재고, 가격, 고객 이력을 공유하므로 쇼퍼가 세 개 부서 대신 한 개의 브랜드를 경험하는 것이다.

segments.src: Buy online / pick up in store, return an online order at the register, ship-from-store, an app that shows real stock at the location nearest you — those are omnichannel plumbing, not marketing copy.
segments.tr: 온라인 구매 / 매장 픽업, 계산대에서 온라인 주문 반품, 매장에서 배송, 가장 가까운 위치의 실제 재고를 보여주는 앱 — 이것들이 옴니채널의 기반 인프라이지, 마케팅 카피가 아니다.

segments.src: **Channel conflict** is the standard failure mode: a new channel eats an existing one.
segments.tr: **채널 충돌**은 표준적인 실패 방식이다: 새로운 채널이 기존 채널을 잠식한다.

segments.src: A brand launches a direct site priced below the retailers who built its shelf presence, and those retailers quietly cut their orders.
segments.tr: 브랜드가 자신의 선반 입점을 구축한 소매업체들보다 저렴하게 책정된 직판 사이트를 출시하고, 그 소매업체들은 조용히 주문을 줄인다.

segments.src: Companies manage this with consistent pricing, channel-specific assortments (the exclusive colorway only Dick's gets), and minimum advertised price policies.
segments.tr: 회사들은 일관된 가격책정, 채널별 상품 구성(Dick's만 얻는 독점 컬러웨이), 최소 광고 가격(MAP) 정책으로 이를 관리한다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: It's Thursday night in Dallas.
segments.tr: 댈러스의 목요일 밤이다.

segments.src: Your kid's birthday party is Saturday and the one thing they asked for is a specific LEGO set.
segments.tr: 아이의 생일 파티가 토요일이고, 아이가 원하는 유일한 것은 특정 레고 세트다.

segments.src: You have options, and each is a different channel structure.
segments.tr: 당신은 선택지가 있고, 각각은 다른 채널 구조다.

segments.src: LEGO's own site is **direct**.
segments.tr: 레고 자체 사이트는 **직접**이다.

segments.src: Amazon is a retailer plus a marketplace of third-party sellers.
segments.tr: 아마존은 소매업체이면서 제3자 판매자의 마켓플레이스다.

segments.src: Target and Walmart are **retailers** buying at wholesale.
segments.tr: 타겟과 월마트는 도매가로 구입하는 **소매업체**다.

segments.src: The independent toy shop two miles away buys through a **distributor**.
segments.tr: 2마일 떨어진 독립적인 장난감 가게는 **유통업체**를 통해 구입한다.

segments.src: You open the Target app, see that the store off I-35 has one on the shelf, order it, and pick it up in an hour.
segments.tr: 당신은 타겟 앱을 열고, I-35 근처의 매장 선반에 하나가 있는 것을 보고, 주문하고, 1시간 후에 픽업한다.

segments.src: Trace what had to happen for that hour to exist.
segments.tr: 그 1시간이 존재하기 위해 무엇이 일어나야 했는지 추적해보자.

segments.src: The set was molded in a factory, containerized, shipped across an ocean, cleared customs, sat in a regional distribution center, rode a truck to that store, got scanned onto a shelf — and the app knew, at store level, that it was there.
segments.tr: 세트는 공장에서 주형되었고, 용기에 담겨졌고, 대양을 건너 배송되었고, 세관을 통과했고, 지역 유통 센터에 있다가, 트럭으로 그 매장까지 갔고, 선반에 스캔되었고 — 앱은 매장 수준에서 그것이 거기 있다는 것을 알고 있었다.

segments.src: That last part is the omnichannel piece.
segments.tr: 그 마지막 부분이 옴니채널의 핵심이다.

segments.src: Same price in the aisle and in the app; an employee picks it; and if it's the wrong set, you can return it at the counter even though you "bought it online."
segments.tr: 통로와 앱에서 같은 가격; 직원이 픽킹하고; 잘못된 세트면, "온라인에서 구입했음에도" 계산대에서 반품할 수 있다.

segments.src: The little toy shop has it too, at full price.
segments.tr: 작은 장난감 가게도 정가에 가지고 있다.

segments.src: It can stock a few thousand different items without opening a few thousand supplier accounts, because a distributor bought the pallet and sold it a case of six.
segments.tr: 유통업체가 팔레트를 구입해서 6개 한 박스로 팔기 때문에, 수천 개의 공급자 계정을 열지 않고도 수천 개의 다른 상품을 비축할 수 있다.

segments.src: That's breaking bulk, and it's the entire reason small retail can exist.
segments.tr: 그것이 대량 분할이고, 소규모 소매가 존재할 수 있는 전체 이유다.

segments.src: Direct looks like a landslide — until you ask how many people were going to type your URL on a Thursday night.
segments.tr: 직접 판매는 압도적으로 보인다 — 목요일 밤에 당신의 URL을 입력할 사람이 몇 명인지 물을 때까지.

segments.src: Retail costs more than half the margin and delivers something direct can't manufacture: being already there, in the store the customer was going to anyway.
segments.tr: 소매는 마진의 절반 이상을 소비하고 직접 판매가 만들어낼 수 없는 것을 제공한다: 고객이 어차피 갈 그 매장에 이미 있는 것.

segments.src: Most brands run both, and spend a lot of effort keeping them from cannibalizing each other.
segments.tr: 대부분의 브랜드는 둘 다 운영하고, 서로를 잠식하지 않도록 많은 노력을 기울인다.

segments.src: That's the whole discipline in one sentence: **place is the practice of buying availability, and deciding what it's worth.**
segments.tr: 그것이 한 문장으로 이 분야의 전부다: **유통은 가용성을 구매하는 실천이며, 그것이 가치 있는 것이 무엇인지를 결정하는 것이다.**

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3줄 요약

segments.src: 1. Place = distribution: the route from maker to user, defined by how many intermediaries are in it and how widely the product is stocked.
segments.tr: 1. 유통 = 분배: 제조자에서 사용자까지의 경로, 중간 거래처가 얼마나 많은지와 제품이 얼마나 광범위하게 공급되는지에 따라 정의된다.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries aren't optional overhead — they perform functions (breaking bulk, inventory risk, credit, assortment, returns) that someone has to perform, so removing them means absorbing them.
segments.tr: 2. 중간 거래처는 선택적 오버헤드가 아니다 — 그들은 누군가가 수행해야 하는 기능들(대량 분할, 재고 위험, 신용, 상품 구성, 반품)을 수행하므로 그들을 제거하는 것은 그 기능들을 흡수하는 것을 의미한다.

segments.src: 3. Omnichannel isn't "selling in many places"; it's channels sharing inventory, price, and customer data so the shopper meets one brand — and adding channels always risks conflict with the ones you already have.
segments.tr: 3. 옴니채널은 "여러 곳에서 판매하는 것"이 아니다; 쇼퍼가 한 개의 브랜드를 만나도록 채널들이 재고, 가격, 고객 데이터를 공유하는 것이다 — 그리고 채널을 추가하는 것은 항상 이미 보유한 채널들과의 충돌 위험이 있다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자체 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** A beverage company wants its new sports drink in every gas station, vending machine, and grocery store it can reach.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 음료 회사가 도달할 수 있는 모든 주유소, 자판기, 슈퍼마켓에 새로운 스포츠 음료를 원한다.

segments.src: Which distribution intensity is this?
segments.tr: 이것은 어떤 유통 집약도인가?

segments.src: A) Exclusive B) Selective C) Intensive D) Direct-only
segments.tr: A) 독점적 B) 선택적 C) 집약적 D) 직접판만

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) A company that sells through its website, a mobile app, and physical stores is by definition running an omnichannel strategy.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) 웹사이트, 모바일 앱, 실제 매장을 통해 판매하는 회사는 정의상 옴니채널 전략을 운영하고 있다.

segments.src: **Q3.** A furniture brand shuts down its wholesale distributor to "cut out the middleman."
segments.tr: **Q3.** 가구 브랜드가 "중간 거래처를 제거"하기 위해 도매 유통업체를 폐쇄한다.

segments.src: Which is the most likely consequence?
segments.tr: 가장 가능성 높은 결과는 무엇인가?

segments.src: A) The distribution functions disappear along with the distributor
segments.tr: A) 유통 기능이 유통업체와 함께 사라진다

segments.src: B) The brand must now carry inventory, ship to stores, and manage returns itself
segments.tr: B) 브랜드는 이제 재고를 보유하고, 매장으로 배송하고, 반품을 스스로 관리해야 한다

segments.src: C) Retail prices automatically fall by the distributor's full margin
segments.tr: C) 소매 가격이 자동으로 유통업체의 전체 마진만큼 떨어진다

segments.src: D) Channel conflict becomes impossible
segments.tr: D) 채널 충돌이 불가능해진다

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — the set of organizations that move a product from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **유통 채널** — 제품을 생산자에서 최종 사용자로 옮기는 조직들의 집합.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — a wholesaler, distributor, or retailer that performs channel functions such as breaking bulk, holding inventory, and extending credit.
segments.tr: - **중간 거래처** — 대량 분할, 재고 보유, 신용 제공 등 채널 기능을 수행하는 도매업체, 유통업체, 소매업체.

segments.src: - **Distribution intensity** — how many outlets carry the product: intensive (everywhere), selective (a curated set), or exclusive (one per territory).
segments.tr: - **유통 집약도** — 제품을 취급하는 점포의 수: 집약적(모든 곳), 선택적(엄선된 집합), 독점적(지역당 하나).

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — channels integrated to share inventory, pricing, and customer data so the experience feels like one brand, versus multichannel silos.
segments.tr: - **옴니채널** — 다중채널 사일로와 달리, 재고, 가격, 고객 데이터를 공유하도록 통합된 채널들로서 경험이 한 개의 브랜드처럼 느껴진다.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — friction that arises when a new or existing channel undercuts another, e.g., a brand's direct site competing with its own retail partners.
segments.tr: - **채널 충돌** — 새로운 또는 기존 채널이 다른 채널을 저격할 때 발생하는 마찰(예: 브랜드의 직판 사이트가 자신의 소매 파트너들과 경쟁함).

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — C.** Maximum coverage for a low-consideration convenience good; shoppers won't search, so absence equals a lost sale.
segments.tr: *답: **Q1 — C.** 낮은 관여도 편의용품을 위한 최대 커버리지; 쇼퍼는 검색하지 않으므로 부재 = 손실된 판매.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** That's multichannel.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (거짓).** 그것은 다중채널이다.

segments.src: It only becomes omnichannel when the channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history — app stock visibility, in-store returns for online orders, and so on.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Channel functions can be shifted, not eliminated; whoever drops out hands the warehousing, shipping, credit, and returns work to someone else — usually the brand.

segments.src: Prices don't automatically drop (A and C are the classic misconception), and going direct typically *increases* conflict risk rather than removing it (D).*

zh.title: 【市场营销101 #9】最好的产品不会赢。能真正买到的产品才会赢。

segments.src: > "Place" isn't about where a product sits. It's about how many steps stand between wanting it and holding it — and who does the work of removing them.
segments.tr: > "渠道"不是指产品放在哪里。它是关于在想要它和拥有它之间需要多少步骤——以及谁来负责消除这些步骤。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Of marketing's four Ps — product, price, promotion, place — **place** is the least glamorous and quietly the most decisive.
segments.tr: 在市场营销的四个P中——产品、价格、推广、渠道——**渠道**是最不引人注目的，也是最具决定性的。

segments.src: It's shorthand for *distribution*: the path a product travels from whoever made it to whoever uses it.
segments.tr: 这是*分销*的简写：产品从制造商到最终使用者的路径。

segments.src: Two questions define that path.
segments.tr: 两个问题定义了这条路径。

segments.src: How many hops?**
segments.tr: 需要多少个环节？**

segments.src: A **direct channel** goes maker → customer: a farmers market stand, a brand's own website, a factory outlet.
segments.tr: **直接渠道**是指制造商→顾客：农贸市场摊位、品牌自己的网站、厂家直销店。

segments.src: An **indirect channel** adds **intermediaries**: manufacturer → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you.
segments.tr: **间接渠道**增加了**中间商**：制造商→批发商/经销商→零售商→你。

segments.src: Each hop takes a slice of margin.
segments.tr: 每个环节都会拿走一部分利润。

segments.src: Each hop also does real work.
segments.tr: 每个环节也都在做实实在在的工作。

segments.src: That's the part people get wrong.
segments.tr: 这就是人们搞错的地方。

segments.src: The common complaint is that middlemen are markup for nothing.
segments.tr: 常见的抱怨是中间商只是在加价，没有增加任何价值。

segments.src: But distribution functions can be *shifted*, not *eliminated*.
segments.tr: 但分销职能可以被*转移*，而不是*消除*。

segments.src: Somebody has to:
segments.tr: 必须有人来：

segments.src: - **Break bulk** — turn a truckload into a shelf's worth
segments.tr: - **拆零** —— 把一卡车的商品分装成货架需要的数量

segments.src: - **Carry inventory** and absorb the risk that it doesn't sell
segments.tr: - **承载库存**并承担卖不出去的风险

segments.src: - **Extend credit** so a small store can stock before it sells
segments.tr: - **提供信贷**让小店在销售前就能进货

segments.src: - **Assemble assortment** so you don't visit 40 brand websites for one shopping trip
segments.tr: - **汇集品种**这样你就不需要为了一次购物访问40个品牌网站

segments.src: - **Handle returns**, damage, and customer questions
segments.tr: - **处理退货**、损坏和客户问题

segments.src: Cut the distributor and you inherit the warehouse, the trucks, the credit risk, and the returns desk.
segments.tr: 切断经销商，你就继承了仓库、卡车、信用风险和售后服务。

segments.src: Sometimes that's worth it.
segments.tr: 有时候这是值得的。

segments.src: It's never free.
segments.tr: 但这绝不是免费的。

segments.src: How widely?**
segments.tr: 覆盖范围有多广？**

segments.src: This is **distribution intensity**, and it has three settings:
segments.tr: 这是**分销强度**，有三种设置：

segments.src: - **Intensive** — everywhere physically possible. Soda, gum, phone chargers, sunscreen. Nobody drives across town for a Coke; if it isn't there, the sale goes to whatever *is*.
segments.tr: - **密集型** —— 在物理上可能的任何地方。汽水、口香糖、手机充电器、防晒霜。没人会为了一瓶可口可乐而跨城开车；如果这里没有，生意就会流向其他品牌。

segments.src: - **Selective** — a curated set of partners. Appliances, mid-tier cosmetics, running shoes. Enough coverage to be findable, few enough to keep service quality up.
segments.tr: - **选择型** —— 精选的合作伙伴。家电、中端化妆品、跑鞋。覆盖足够广泛以便能找到，但足够有限以保持服务质量。

segments.src: - **Exclusive** — one partner per territory. Luxury watches, car dealerships, high-end audio. Scarcity and service are part of the product.
segments.tr: - **独家型** —— 每个地区一个合作伙伴。奢侈手表、汽车经销店、高端音频设备。稀缺性和服务是产品的一部分。

segments.src: The right setting follows how people shop.
segments.tr: 正确的设置应该遵循人们的购物方式。

segments.src: The less someone is willing to search, the more intensive you must be.
segments.tr: 人们越不愿意寻找，你就必须越密集地布局。

segments.src: **Multichannel vs.
segments.tr: **多渠道 vs.

segments.src: omnichannel.** These get used interchangeably and shouldn't be.
segments.tr: 全渠道。** 这两个术语经常被混用，但本不应该这样。

segments.src: *Multichannel* means you sell in several places, each running as its own silo — the website has no idea what the store has.
segments.tr: *多渠道*意味着你在多个地方销售，每个地方各自为政—— 网站不知道店铺有什么。

segments.src: *Omnichannel* means those channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history, so the shopper experiences one brand instead of three departments.
segments.tr: *全渠道*意味着这些渠道共享库存、价格和客户历史记录，所以购物者体验到的是一个品牌而不是三个部门。

segments.src: Buy online / pick up in store, return an online order at the register, ship-from-store, an app that shows real stock at the location nearest you — those are omnichannel plumbing, not marketing copy.
segments.tr: 在线购买/到店提货、在收银台退回网上订单、门店发货、应用显示距离最近门店的实际库存——这些是全渠道基础设施，不是营销噱头。

segments.src: **Channel conflict** is the standard failure mode: a new channel eats an existing one.
segments.tr: **渠道冲突**是标准的失败模式：新渠道侵蚀现有渠道。

segments.src: A brand launches a direct site priced below the retailers who built its shelf presence, and those retailers quietly cut their orders.
segments.tr: 一个品牌推出直销网站，价格低于帮它建立货架存在的零售商，那些零售商就会悄悄减少订单。

segments.src: Companies manage this with consistent pricing, channel-specific assortments (the exclusive colorway only Dick's gets), and minimum advertised price policies.
segments.tr: 公司通过统一定价、特定渠道的产品组合（比如只有Dick's有的独家配色）和最低广告价政策来管理这个问题。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中

segments.src: It's Thursday night in Dallas.
segments.tr: 现在是达拉斯的星期四晚上。

segments.src: Your kid's birthday party is Saturday and the one thing they asked for is a specific LEGO set.
segments.tr: 孩子的生日派对是星期六，他唯一想要的是一套特定的乐高。

segments.src: You have options, and each is a different channel structure.
segments.tr: 你有几个选择，每个都是不同的渠道结构。

segments.src: LEGO's own site is **direct**.
segments.tr: 乐高自己的网站是**直接渠道**。

segments.src: Amazon is a retailer plus a marketplace of third-party sellers.
segments.tr: 亚马逊既是零售商又是第三方卖家的市场。

segments.src: Target and Walmart are **retailers** buying at wholesale.
segments.tr: Target和沃尔玛是以批发价购买的**零售商**。

segments.src: The independent toy shop two miles away buys through a **distributor**.
segments.tr: 两英里外的独立玩具店通过**经销商**进货。

segments.src: You open the Target app, see that the store off I-35 has one on the shelf, order it, and pick it up in an hour.
segments.tr: 你打开Target应用，看到I-35州际公路附近的那家店货架上有一套，下单后一小时就能去取。

segments.src: Trace what had to happen for that hour to exist.
segments.tr: 追踪一下为了那一小时的提货时间需要发生什么。

segments.src: The set was molded in a factory, containerized, shipped across an ocean, cleared customs, sat in a regional distribution center, rode a truck to that store, got scanned onto a shelf — and the app knew, at store level, that it was there.
segments.tr: 这套乐高在工厂成型、装箱、跨海运送、通过海关、在地区分销中心存放、坐车到达那家门店、扫描上架——而应用在门店级别知道它在那里。

segments.src: That last part is the omnichannel piece.
segments.tr: 最后这一部分就是全渠道的内核。

segments.src: Same price in the aisle and in the app; an employee picks it; and if it's the wrong set, you can return it at the counter even though you "bought it online."
segments.tr: 过道和应用中的价格相同；员工给你拿货；如果拿错了，即使你是"在线购买"也可以在收银台退货。

segments.src: The little toy shop has it too, at full price.
segments.tr: 小玩具店也有，但价格是全价。

segments.src: It can stock a few thousand different items without opening a few thousand supplier accounts, because a distributor bought the pallet and sold it a case of six.
segments.tr: 它可以不用开设数千个供应商账户就能存放几千种不同的商品，因为一个经销商买了一整板，以六件为一箱卖给它。

segments.src: That's breaking bulk, and it's the entire reason small retail can exist.
segments.tr: 这就是拆零，这也是小零售店能存在的根本原因。

segments.src: Now the brand's side of the tradeoff, using illustrative numbers (not LEGO's real ones):
segments.tr: 现在看品牌端的权衡，用示意数字（不是乐高的真实数字）：

segments.src: Direct (brand.com)
segments.tr: Direct (brand.com)

segments.src: $49.99 paid  -  ~$7 pick/pack/ship  -  ~$4 payments & returns   =  ~$39 to the brand
segments.tr: $49.99 paid  -  ~$7 pick/pack/ship  -  ~$4 payments & returns   =  ~$39 to the brand

segments.src: Through retail
segments.tr: Through retail

segments.src: brand -> distributor: ~$22
segments.tr: brand -> distributor: ~$22

segments.src: distributor -> store: ~$28
segments.tr: distributor -> store: ~$28

segments.src: store -> shopper:     $49.99                                     =  ~$22 to the brand
segments.tr: store -> shopper:     $49.99                                     =  ~$22 to the brand

segments.src: Direct looks like a landslide — until you ask how many people were going to type your URL on a Thursday night.
segments.tr: 直销看起来是压倒性的——直到你问有多少人会在星期四晚上输入你的网址。

segments.src: Retail costs more than half the margin and delivers something direct can't manufacture: being already there, in the store the customer was going to anyway.
segments.tr: 零售花费超过一半的利润，但提供了直销无法生产的东西：已经在那里，在顾客本来就要去的商店里。

segments.src: Most brands run both, and spend a lot of effort keeping them from cannibalizing each other.
segments.tr: 大多数品牌同时运营两者，花费大量精力防止它们互相蚕食。

segments.src: That's the whole discipline in one sentence: **place is the practice of buying availability, and deciding what it's worth.**
segments.tr: 这就是整个学科用一句话概括：**渠道是购买可用性的实践，以及决定这值多少钱。**

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. Place = distribution: the route from maker to user, defined by how many intermediaries are in it and how widely the product is stocked.
segments.tr: 1. 渠道 = 分销：从制造商到用户的路线，由其中有多少中间商以及产品分布范围有多广来定义。

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries aren't optional overhead — they perform functions (breaking bulk, inventory risk, credit, assortment, returns) that someone has to perform, so removing them means absorbing them.
segments.tr: 2. 中间商不是可选的成本——他们执行某些必须有人执行的职能（拆零、库存风险、信贷、品种组合、退货），所以消除他们意味着自己承担这些职能。

segments.src: 3. Omnichannel isn't "selling in many places"; it's channels sharing inventory, price, and customer data so the shopper meets one brand — and adding channels always risks conflict with the ones you already have.
segments.tr: 3. 全渠道不是"在很多地方销售"；而是渠道共享库存、价格和客户数据，所以购物者遇到的是一个品牌——而增加渠道总是存在与现有渠道冲突的风险。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测

segments.src: **Q1.** A beverage company wants its new sports drink in every gas station, vending machine, and grocery store it can reach.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 一个饮料公司希望其新运动饮料能在它能到达的每家加油站、自动贩卖机和杂货店。

segments.src: Which distribution intensity is this?
segments.tr: 这是哪种分销强度？

segments.src: A) Exclusive B) Selective C) Intensive D) Direct-only
segments.tr: A) 独家型 B) 选择型 C) 密集型 D) 仅直销

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) A company that sells through its website, a mobile app, and physical stores is by definition running an omnichannel strategy.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (对/错) 一家通过网站、移动应用和实体店销售的公司按定义是在运营全渠道战略。

segments.src: **Q3.** A furniture brand shuts down its wholesale distributor to "cut out the middleman."
segments.tr: **Q3.** 一个家具品牌关闭了批发经销商以"切掉中间商"。

segments.src: Which is the most likely consequence?
segments.tr: 最可能的后果是什么？

segments.src: A) The distribution functions disappear along with the distributor
segments.tr: A) 分销职能随经销商一起消失

segments.src: B) The brand must now carry inventory, ship to stores, and manage returns itself
segments.tr: B) 该品牌现在必须自己承载库存、向商店发货和管理退货

segments.src: C) Retail prices automatically fall by the distributor's full margin
segments.tr: C) 零售价自动下降相当于经销商的全部利润

segments.src: D) Channel conflict becomes impossible
segments.tr: D) 渠道冲突变得不可能

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — the set of organizations that move a product from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **分销渠道** —— 把产品从生产者移动到最终用户的一套组织。

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — a wholesaler, distributor, or retailer that performs channel functions such as breaking bulk, holding inventory, and extending credit.
segments.tr: - **中间商** —— 批发商、经销商或零售商，执行拆零、持有库存和提供信贷等渠道职能。

segments.src: - **Distribution intensity** — how many outlets carry the product: intensive (everywhere), selective (a curated set), or exclusive (one per territory).
segments.tr: - **分销强度** —— 有多少个门店出售该产品：密集型（无处不在）、选择型（精选集合）或独家型（每个地区一个）。

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — channels integrated to share inventory, pricing, and customer data so the experience feels like one brand, versus multichannel silos.
segments.tr: - **全渠道** —— 集成的渠道共享库存、定价和客户数据，使体验感觉像一个品牌，相对于多渠道孤立。

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — friction that arises when a new or existing channel undercuts another, e.g., a brand's direct site competing with its own retail partners.
segments.tr: - **渠道冲突** —— 当新渠道或现有渠道削弱另一个渠道时产生的摩擦，例如一个品牌的直销网站与其零售合作伙伴竞争。

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — C.** Maximum coverage for a low-consideration convenience good; shoppers won't search, so absence equals a lost sale.
segments.tr: *答案：**Q1 — C。** 低卖点便利商品的最大覆盖范围；购物者不会寻找，所以缺货等于失去一笔销售。

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** That's multichannel.
segments.tr: **Q2 — 错。** 那是多渠道。

segments.src: It only becomes omnichannel when the channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history — app stock visibility, in-store returns for online orders, and so on.
segments.tr: 只有当渠道共享库存、定价和客户历史记录时才成为全渠道——应用库存可见性、在线订单的店内退货等等。

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Channel functions can be shifted, not eliminated; whoever drops out hands the warehousing, shipping, credit, and returns work to someone else — usually the brand.
segments.tr: **Q3 — B。** 渠道职能可以转移，不能消除；谁退出了就把仓储、配送、信用和退货工作交给别人——通常是品牌自己。

segments.src: Prices don't automatically drop (A and C are the classic misconception), and going direct typically *increases* conflict risk rather than removing it (D).*
segments.tr: 价格不会自动下降（A和C是经典的误解），直销通常会*增加*冲突风险而不是消除它（D）。*

segments.tr: कितनी हॉप्स?**

segments.src: A **direct channel** goes maker → customer: a farmers market stand, a brand's own website, a factory outlet.
segments.tr: एक **प्रत्यक्ष चैनल** निर्माता → ग्राहक जाता है: एक किसान बाजार की दुकान, ब्रांड की अपनी वेबसाइट, एक कारखाना आउटलेट।

segments.src: An **indirect channel** adds **intermediaries**: manufacturer → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you.
segments.tr: एक **अप्रत्यक्ष चैनल** **मध्यस्थों** को जोड़ता है: निर्माता → थोक विक्रेता/वितरक → खुदरा विक्रेता → आप।

segments.src: Each hop takes a slice of margin.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक हॉप मार्जिन का एक हिस्सा लेता है।

segments.src: Each hop also does real work.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक हॉप वास्तविक काम भी करता है।

segments.src: That's the part people get wrong.
segments.tr: यह वह हिस्सा है जो लोग गलत समझते हैं।

segments.src: The common complaint is that middlemen are markup for nothing.
segments.tr: आम शिकायत यह है कि मध्यस्थ केवल कीमत बढ़ाते हैं।

segments.src: But distribution functions can be *shifted*, not *eliminated*.
segments.tr: लेकिन वितरण कार्य *स्थानांतरित* हो सकते हैं, *समाप्त* नहीं हो सकते।

segments.src: Somebody has to:
segments.tr: किसी को करना होगा:

segments.src: - **Break bulk** — turn a truckload into a shelf's worth
segments.tr: - **थोक विभाजन** — एक ट्रकलोड को शेल्फ के लायक में बदलना

segments.src: - **Carry inventory** and absorb the risk that it doesn't sell
segments.tr: - **इन्वेंटरी रखें** और उस जोखिम को सहें कि यह न बिके

segments.src: - **Extend credit** so a small store can stock before it sells
segments.tr: - **क्रेडिट दें** ताकि एक छोटी दुकान बिक्रय से पहले स्टॉक कर सके

segments.src: - **Assemble assortment** so you don't visit 40 brand websites for one shopping trip
segments.tr: - **विविध संग्रह तैयार करें** ताकि आप एक खरीदारी यात्रा के लिए 40 ब्रांड वेबसाइटों पर न जाएं

segments.src: - **Handle returns**, damage, and customer questions
segments.tr: - **रिटर्न, नुकसान, और ग्राहक प्रश्नों को संभालें**

segments.src: Cut the distributor and you inherit the warehouse, the trucks, the credit risk, and the returns desk.
segments.tr: वितरक को काटें और आप गोदाम, ट्रक, क्रेडिट जोखिम, और रिटर्न डेस्क को विरासत में लेते हैं।

segments.src: Sometimes that's worth it.
segments.tr: कभी-कभी यह इसके लायक होता है।

segments.src: It's never free.
segments.tr: यह कभी मुफ्त नहीं होता है।

segments.src: How widely?**
segments.tr: कितनी व्यापक रूप से?**

segments.src: This is **distribution intensity**, and it has three settings:
segments.tr: यह **वितरण तीव्रता** है, और इसके तीन सेटिंग्स हैं:

segments.src: - **Intensive** — everywhere physically possible. Soda, gum, phone chargers, sunscreen. Nobody drives across town for a Coke; if it isn't there, the sale goes to whatever *is*.
segments.tr: - **गहन** — हर जगह जहाँ शारीरिक रूप से संभव हो। सोडा, च्यूइंग गम, फोन चार्जर, सनस्क्रीन। कोई भी Coke के लिए शहर में ड्राइव नहीं करता; अगर यह वहाँ नहीं है, तो बिक्रय जो कुछ भी *उपलब्ध* है वह ले जाता है।

segments.src: - **Selective** — a curated set of partners. Appliances, mid-tier cosmetics, running shoes. Enough coverage to be findable, few enough to keep service quality up.
segments.tr: - **चयनात्मक** — भागीदारों का एक क्यूरेटेड सेट। उपकरण, मध्य-स्तरीय सौंदर्य प्रसाधन, दौड़ने के जूते। खोजने योग्य होने के लिए पर्याप्त कवरेज, सेवा गुणवत्ता बनाए रखने के लिए पर्याप्त कम।

segments.src: - **Exclusive** — one partner per territory. Luxury watches, car dealerships, high-end audio. Scarcity and service are part of the product.
segments.tr: - **एकमात्र** — प्रति क्षेत्र एक भागीदार। विलासवान घड़ियाँ, कार डीलरशिप, उच्च-अंत ऑडियो। दुर्लभता और सेवा उत्पाद का हिस्सा हैं।

segments.src: The right setting follows how people shop.
segments.tr: सही सेटिंग इस बात का पालन करती है कि लोग कैसे खरीदारी करते हैं।

segments.src: The less someone is willing to search, the more intensive you must be.
segments.tr: जितना कम कोई खोज करने के लिए तैयार है, उतना अधिक गहन आपको होना चाहिए।

segments.src: **Multichannel vs.
segments.tr: **मल्टीचैनल बनाम।

segments.src: omnichannel.** These get used interchangeably and shouldn't be.
segments.tr: ओमनीचैनल।** ये एक दूसरे के स्थान पर उपयोग किए जाते हैं और नहीं होने चाहिए।

segments.src: *Multichannel* means you sell in several places, each running as its own silo — the website has no idea what the store has.
segments.tr: *मल्टीचैनल* का अर्थ है आप कई जगहों पर बेचते हैं, प्रत्येक अपने स्वयं के साइलो के रूप में चलता है — वेबसाइट को पता नहीं है कि स्टोर के पास क्या है।

segments.src: *Omnichannel* means those channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history, so the shopper experiences one brand instead of three departments.
segments.tr: *ओमनीचैनल* का अर्थ है कि वे चैनल इन्वेंटरी, मूल्य निर्धारण, और ग्राहक इतिहास साझा करते हैं, इसलिए खरीदार तीन विभागों के बजाय एक ब्रांड का अनुभव करता है।

segments.src: Buy online / pick up in store, return an online order at the register, ship-from-store, an app that shows real stock at the location nearest you — those are omnichannel plumbing, not marketing copy.
segments.tr: ऑनलाइन खरीदें / स्टोर में उठाएं, रजिस्टर पर ऑनलाइन ऑर्डर वापस करें, स्टोर से शिप करें, एक ऐप जो आपके निकटतम स्थान पर वास्तविक स्टॉक दिखाता है — ये ओमनीचैनल अवसंरचना हैं, विपणन बातें नहीं।

segments.src: **Channel conflict** is the standard failure mode: a new channel eats an existing one.
segments.tr: **चैनल संघर्ष** मानक विफलता मोड है: एक नया चैनल एक मौजूदा को खा जाता है।

segments.src: A brand launches a direct site priced below the retailers who built its shelf presence, and those retailers quietly cut their orders.
segments.tr: एक ब्रांड एक प्रत्यक्ष साइट लॉन्च करता है जिसकी कीमत उन खुदरा विक्रेताओं से कम है जिन्होंने इसकी शेल्फ उपस्थिति बनाई, और वे खुदरा विक्रेता चुपचाप अपने ऑर्डर काटते हैं।

segments.src: Companies manage this with consistent pricing, channel-specific assortments (the exclusive colorway only Dick's gets), and minimum advertised price policies.
segments.tr: कंपनियां इसे सुसंगत मूल्य निर्धारण, चैनल-विशिष्ट विविधताओं (एकमात्र रंग जो केवल Dick's को मिलता है), और न्यूनतम विज्ञापित मूल्य नीतियों के साथ प्रबंधित करती हैं।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में

segments.src: It's Thursday night in Dallas.
segments.tr: यह Dallas में गुरुवार की रात है।

segments.src: Your kid's birthday party is Saturday and the one thing they asked for is a specific LEGO set.
segments.tr: आपके बच्चे की जन्मदिन की पार्टी शनिवार है और वह एकमात्र चीज़ जो वे मांगते हैं एक विशिष्ट LEGO सेट है।

segments.src: You have options, and each is a different channel structure.
segments.tr: आपके पास विकल्प हैं, और प्रत्येक एक अलग चैनल संरचना है।

segments.src: LEGO's own site is **direct**.
segments.tr: LEGO की अपनी साइट **प्रत्यक्ष** है।

segments.src: Amazon is a retailer plus a marketplace of third-party sellers.
segments.tr: Amazon एक खुदरा विक्रेता और तीसरे पक्ष के विक्रेताओं का एक बाजार है।

segments.src: Target and Walmart are **retailers** buying at wholesale.
segments.tr: Target और Walmart **खुदरा विक्रेता** हैं जो थोक में खरीद रहे हैं।

segments.src: The independent toy shop two miles away buys through a **distributor**.
segments.tr: दो मील दूर की स्वतंत्र खिलौना दुकान एक **वितरक** के माध्यम से खरीद करती है।

segments.src: You open the Target app, see that the store off I-35 has one on the shelf, order it, and pick it up in an hour.
segments.tr: आप Target ऐप खोलते हैं, देखते हैं कि I-35 से दूर की दुकान के पास शेल्फ पर एक है, इसे ऑर्डर करते हैं, और एक घंटे में इसे उठा लेते हैं।

segments.src: Trace what had to happen for that hour to exist.
segments.tr: ट्रेस करें कि उस घंटे को संभव बनाने के लिए क्या होना था।

segments.src: The set was molded in a factory, containerized, shipped across an ocean, cleared customs, sat in a regional distribution center, rode a truck to that store, got scanned onto a shelf — and the app knew, at store level, that it was there.
segments.tr: सेट एक कारखाने में ढाला गया था, कंटेनर में रखा गया था, एक महासागर में भेज दिया गया था, सीमा शुल्क साफ किया गया था, एक क्षेत्रीय वितरण केंद्र में बैठ गया था, उस स्टोर में एक ट्रक में सवार था, एक शेल्फ पर स्कैन किया गया था — और ऐप जानता था, स्टोर स्तर पर, कि यह वहाँ था।

segments.src: That last part is the omnichannel piece.
segments.tr: वह अंतिम भाग ओमनीचैनल टुकड़ा है।

segments.src: Same price in the aisle and in the app; an employee picks it; and if it's the wrong set, you can return it at the counter even though you "bought it online."
segments.tr: गली में और ऐप में समान कीमत; एक कर्मचारी इसे उठाता है; और अगर यह गलत सेट है, तो आप इसे काउंटर पर वापस कर सकते हैं भले ही आपने इसे "ऑनलाइन खरीदा" हो।

segments.src: The little toy shop has it too, at full price.
segments.tr: छोटी खिलौना दुकान के पास भी यह है, पूरी कीमत पर।

segments.src: It can stock a few thousand different items without opening a few thousand supplier accounts, because a distributor bought the pallet and sold it a case of six.
segments.tr: यह कुछ हज़ार अलग-अलग आइटम स्टॉक कर सकता है बिना कुछ हज़ार आपूर्तिकर्ता खातों को खोले, क्योंकि एक वितरक ने पैलेट खरीद और इसे छह का एक मामला बेच दिया।

segments.src: That's breaking bulk, and it's the entire reason small retail can exist.
segments.tr: यह थोक विभाजन है, और यह छोटे खुदरा के अस्तित्व का पूरा कारण है।

segments.src: Direct looks like a landslide — until you ask how many people were going to type your URL on a Thursday night.
segments.tr: प्रत्यक्ष एक भूस्खलन की तरह दिखता है — जब तक आप नहीं पूछते कि कितने लोग गुरुवार की रात को आपके URL को टाइप करने वाले थे।

segments.src: Retail costs more than half the margin and delivers something direct can't manufacture: being already there, in the store the customer was going to anyway.
segments.tr: खुदरा आधे से अधिक मार्जिन की लागत है और कुछ ऐसा देता है जो प्रत्यक्ष निर्माण नहीं कर सकता: पहले से वहाँ होना, उस स्टोर में जहाँ ग्राहक वैसे भी जाने वाला था।

segments.src: Most brands run both, and spend a lot of effort keeping them from cannibalizing each other.
segments.tr: अधिकांश ब्रांड दोनों चलाते हैं, और उन्हें एक दूसरे को नष्ट करने से रोकने के लिए बहुत प्रयास खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: That's the whole discipline in one sentence: **place is the practice of buying availability, and deciding what it's worth.**
segments.tr: यह पूरी अनुशासन एक वाक्य में है: **स्थान उपलब्धता खरीदने का अभ्यास है, और यह तय करना है कि यह क्या लायक है।**

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3-पंक्ति पुनरावृत्ति

segments.src: 1. Place = distribution: the route from maker to user, defined by how many intermediaries are in it and how widely the product is stocked.
segments.tr: 1. स्थान = वितरण: निर्माता से उपयोगकर्ता तक का मार्ग, इस बात से परिभाषित कि इसमें कितने मध्यस्थ हैं और उत्पाद कितनी व्यापक रूप से स्टॉक किया जाता है।

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries aren't optional overhead — they perform functions (breaking bulk, inventory risk, credit, assortment, returns) that someone has to perform, so removing them means absorbing them.
segments.tr: 2. मध्यस्थ वैकल्पिक ओवरहेड नहीं हैं — वे कार्य करते हैं (थोक विभाजन, इन्वेंटरी जोखिम, क्रेडिट, विविधता, रिटर्न) जो किसी को करना है, इसलिए उन्हें हटाने का अर्थ है उन्हें अवशोषित करना।

segments.src: 3. Omnichannel isn't "selling in many places"; it's channels sharing inventory, price, and customer data so the shopper meets one brand — and adding channels always risks conflict with the ones you already have.
segments.tr: 3. ओमनीचैनल "कई जगहों पर बेचना" नहीं है; यह चैनल इन्वेंटरी, मूल्य, और ग्राहक डेटा साझा करना है ताकि खरीदार एक ब्रांड से मिले — और चैनल जोड़ना हमेशा उन लोगों के साथ संघर्ष का जोखिम है जो आपके पास पहले से हैं।

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्व-प्रश्नावली

segments.src: **Q1.** A beverage company wants its new sports drink in every gas station, vending machine, and grocery store it can reach.
segments.tr: **Q1.** एक पेय कंपनी अपनी नई स्पोर्ट्स ड्रिंक को हर गैस स्टेशन, वेंडिंग मशीन, और किराना स्टोर में पहुँचाना चाहती है।

segments.src: Which distribution intensity is this?
segments.tr: यह कौन सी वितरण तीव्रता है?

segments.src: A) Exclusive B) Selective C) Intensive D) Direct-only
segments.tr: A) एकमात्र B) चयनात्मक C) गहन D) केवल प्रत्यक्ष

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) A company that sells through its website, a mobile app, and physical stores is by definition running an omnichannel strategy.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (हाँ/नहीं) एक कंपनी जो अपनी वेबसाइट, एक मोबाइल ऐप, और भौतिक स्टोर के माध्यम से बेचती है, परिभाषा के अनुसार एक ओमनीचैनल रणनीति चला रही है।

segments.src: **Q3.** A furniture brand shuts down its wholesale distributor to "cut out the middleman."
segments.tr: **Q3.** एक फर्नीचर ब्रांड "मध्यस्थ को काटने" के लिए अपने थोक वितरक को बंद कर देता है।

segments.src: Which is the most likely consequence?
segments.tr: सबसे संभावित परिणाम कौन सा है?

segments.src: A) The distribution functions disappear along with the distributor
segments.tr: A) वितरण कार्य वितरक के साथ गायब हो जाते हैं

segments.src: B) The brand must now carry inventory, ship to stores, and manage returns itself
segments.tr: B) ब्रांड को अब इन्वेंटरी ले जानी चाहिए, दुकानों को शिप करना चाहिए, और रिटर्न स्वयं संभालना चाहिए

segments.src: C) Retail prices automatically fall by the distributor's full margin
segments.tr: C) खुदरा कीमतें स्वचालित रूप से वितरक के पूर्ण मार्जिन से गिरती हैं

segments.src: D) Channel conflict becomes impossible
segments.tr: D) चैनल संघर्ष असंभव हो जाता है

segments.tr: ## 📚 आज के शब्द

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — the set of organizations that move a product from producer to end user.
segments.tr: - **वितरण चैनल** — संगठनों का सेट जो एक उत्पाद को निर्माता से अंतिम उपयोगकर्ता तक ले जाता है।

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — a wholesaler, distributor, or retailer that performs channel functions such as breaking bulk, holding inventory, and extending credit.
segments.tr: - **मध्यस्थ** — एक थोक विक्रेता, वितरक, या खुदरा विक्रेता जो चैनल कार्य करता है जैसे थोक विभाजन, इन्वेंटरी रखना, और क्रेडिट देना।

segments.src: - **Distribution intensity** — how many outlets carry the product: intensive (everywhere), selective (a curated set), or exclusive (one per territory).
segments.tr: - **वितरण तीव्रता** — कितने आउटलेट उत्पाद ले जाते हैं: गहन (हर जगह), चयनात्मक (एक क्यूरेटेड सेट), या एकमात्र (प्रति क्षेत्र एक)।

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — channels integrated to share inventory, pricing, and customer data so the experience feels like one brand, versus multichannel silos.
segments.tr: - **ओमनीचैनल** — चैनल इन्वेंटरी, मूल्य निर्धारण, और ग्राहक डेटा साझा करने के लिए एकीकृत, ताकि अनुभव एक ब्रांड की तरह लगे, बनाम मल्टीचैनल साइलो।

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — friction that arises when a new or existing channel undercuts another, e.g., a brand's direct site competing with its own retail partners.
segments.tr: - **चैनल संघर्ष** — घर्षण जो तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक नया या मौजूदा चैनल दूसरे को कमतर करता है, उदाहरण के लिए, एक ब्रांड की प्रत्यक्ष साइट अपने स्वयं के खुदरा भागीदारों के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करती है।

es.title: [Marketing 101 #9] El mejor producto no gana. El que realmente puedes obtener sí.

segments.src: > "Place" isn't about where a product sits. It's about how many steps stand between wanting it and holding it — and who does the work of removing them.
segments.tr: > "Lugar" no se trata de dónde está un producto. Se trata de cuántos pasos hay entre desearlo y tenerlo — y quién hace el trabajo de eliminarlos.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## El concepto de hoy

segments.src: Of marketing's four Ps — product, price, promotion, place — **place** is the least glamorous and quietly the most decisive.
segments.tr: De las cuatro P del marketing — producto, precio, promoción, lugar — **lugar** es la menos glamorosa y silenciosamente la más decisiva.

segments.src: It's shorthand for *distribution*: the path a product travels from whoever made it to whoever uses it.
segments.tr: Es sinónimo de *distribución*: el camino que recorre un producto desde quien lo hizo hasta quien lo usa.

segments.src: Two questions define that path.
segments.tr: Dos preguntas definen ese camino.

segments.src: How many hops?**
segments.tr: ¿Cuántos saltos?**

segments.src: A **direct channel** goes maker → customer: a farmers market stand, a brand's own website, a factory outlet.
segments.tr: Un **canal directo** va fabricante → cliente: un puesto de mercado de agricultores, el sitio web de una marca, una tienda de fábrica.

segments.src: An **indirect channel** adds **intermediaries**: manufacturer → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you.
segments.tr: Un **canal indirecto** añade **intermediarios**: fabricante → mayorista/distribuidor → minorista → tú.

segments.src: Each hop takes a slice of margin.
segments.tr: Cada salto se lleva una parte del margen.

segments.src: Each hop also does real work.
segments.tr: Cada salto también realiza trabajo real.

segments.src: That's the part people get wrong.
segments.tr: Esa es la parte que la gente se equivoca.

segments.src: The common complaint is that middlemen are markup for nothing.
segments.tr: La queja común es que los intermediarios son un margen por nada.

segments.src: But distribution functions can be *shifted*, not *eliminated*.
segments.tr: Pero las funciones de distribución pueden ser *desplazadas*, no *eliminadas*.

segments.src: Somebody has to:
segments.tr: Alguien tiene que:

segments.src: - **Break bulk** — turn a truckload into a shelf's worth
segments.tr: - **Dividir el lote** — convertir un camión completo en lo que cabe en una estantería

segments.src: - **Carry inventory** and absorb the risk that it doesn't sell
segments.tr: - **Llevar inventario** y absorber el riesgo de que no se venda

segments.src: - **Extend credit** so a small store can stock before it sells
segments.tr: - **Otorgar crédito** para que una pequeña tienda pueda surtirse antes de vender

segments.src: - **Assemble assortment** so you don't visit 40 brand websites for one shopping trip
segments.tr: - **Armar surtido** para que no visites 40 sitios web de marcas por un viaje de compras

segments.src: - **Handle returns**, damage, and customer questions
segments.tr: - **Manejar devoluciones**, daños y preguntas de clientes

segments.src: Cut the distributor and you inherit the warehouse, the trucks, the credit risk, and the returns desk.
segments.tr: Elimina al distribuidor y heredas el almacén, los camiones, el riesgo crediticio y el mostrador de devoluciones.

segments.src: Sometimes that's worth it.
segments.tr: A veces vale la pena.

segments.src: It's never free.
segments.tr: Nunca es gratis.

segments.src: How widely?**
segments.tr: ¿Cuán ampliamente?**

segments.src: This is **distribution intensity**, and it has three settings:
segments.tr: Esta es la **intensidad de distribución**, y tiene tres configuraciones:

segments.src: - **Intensive** — everywhere physically possible. Soda, gum, phone chargers, sunscreen. Nobody drives across town for a Coke; if it isn't there, the sale goes to whatever *is*.
segments.tr: - **Intensiva** — en todos lados donde sea físicamente posible. Refrescos, chicle, cargadores de teléfono, protector solar. Nadie cruza la ciudad por una Coca-Cola; si no está ahí, la venta va a lo que *sí está*.

segments.src: - **Selective** — a curated set of partners. Appliances, mid-tier cosmetics, running shoes. Enough coverage to be findable, few enough to keep service quality up.
segments.tr: - **Selectiva** — un conjunto seleccionado de socios. Electrodomésticos, cosméticos de gama media, zapatillas para correr. Cobertura suficiente para ser encontrado, pero lo suficientemente limitada para mantener la calidad del servicio.

segments.src: - **Exclusive** — one partner per territory. Luxury watches, car dealerships, high-end audio. Scarcity and service are part of the product.
segments.tr: - **Exclusiva** — un socio por territorio. Relojes de lujo, concesionarios de automóviles, audio de alta gama. La escasez y el servicio son parte del producto.

segments.src: The right setting follows how people shop.
segments.tr: La configuración correcta sigue cómo compra la gente.

segments.src: The less someone is willing to search, the more intensive you must be.
segments.tr: Cuanto menos esté dispuesto alguien a buscar, más intensivo debes ser.

segments.src: **Multichannel vs.
segments.tr: **Multicanal vs.

segments.src: omnichannel.** These get used interchangeably and shouldn't be.
segments.tr: omnicanal.** Estos se usan indistintamente y no debería ser así.

segments.src: *Multichannel* means you sell in several places, each running as its own silo — the website has no idea what the store has.
segments.tr: *Multicanal* significa que vendes en varios lugares, cada uno funcionando como su propio silo — el sitio web no sabe qué tiene la tienda.

segments.src: *Omnichannel* means those channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history, so the shopper experiences one brand instead of three departments.
segments.tr: *Omnicanal* significa que esos canales comparten inventario, precios e historial de clientes, para que el comprador experimente una marca en lugar de tres departamentos.

segments.src: Buy online / pick up in store, return an online order at the register, ship-from-store, an app that shows real stock at the location nearest you — those are omnichannel plumbing, not marketing copy.
segments.tr: Compra en línea / recoge en la tienda, devuelve un pedido en línea en la caja, envío desde la tienda, una aplicación que muestra stock real en la ubicación más cercana — esos son tuberías omnicanal, no textos de marketing.

segments.src: **Channel conflict** is the standard failure mode: a new channel eats an existing one.
segments.tr: El **conflicto de canal** es el modo de falla estándar: un canal nuevo se come uno existente.

segments.src: A brand launches a direct site priced below the retailers who built its shelf presence, and those retailers quietly cut their orders.
segments.tr: Una marca lanza un sitio directo con precios inferiores a los minoristas que construyeron su presencia en las estanterías, y esos minoristas reducen silenciosamente sus pedidos.

segments.src: Companies manage this with consistent pricing, channel-specific assortments (the exclusive colorway only Dick's gets), and minimum advertised price policies.
segments.tr: Las empresas manejan esto con precios consistentes, surtidos específicos por canal (la combinación de colores exclusiva que solo Dick's obtiene), y políticas de precio mínimo anunciado.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: It's Thursday night in Dallas.
segments.tr: Es jueves por la noche en Dallas.

segments.src: Your kid's birthday party is Saturday and the one thing they asked for is a specific LEGO set.
segments.tr: La fiesta de cumpleaños de tu hijo es el sábado y lo único que pidió es un set específico de LEGO.

segments.src: You have options, and each is a different channel structure.
segments.tr: Tienes opciones, y cada una es una estructura de canal diferente.

segments.src: LEGO's own site is **direct**.
segments.tr: El sitio propio de LEGO es **directo**.

segments.src: Amazon is a retailer plus a marketplace of third-party sellers.
segments.tr: Amazon es un minorista además de un mercado de vendedores de terceros.

segments.src: Target and Walmart are **retailers** buying at wholesale.
segments.tr: Target y Walmart son **minoristas** que compran al por mayor.

segments.src: The independent toy shop two miles away buys through a **distributor**.
segments.tr: La tienda de juguetes independiente a dos millas compra a través de un **distribuidor**.

segments.src: You open the Target app, see that the store off I-35 has one on the shelf, order it, and pick it up in an hour.
segments.tr: Abres la aplicación de Target, ves que la tienda fuera de I-35 tiene uno en la estantería, lo ordenas y lo recoges en una hora.

segments.src: Trace what had to happen for that hour to exist.
segments.tr: Rastrear lo que tuvo que suceder para que esa hora existiera.

segments.src: The set was molded in a factory, containerized, shipped across an ocean, cleared customs, sat in a regional distribution center, rode a truck to that store, got scanned onto a shelf — and the app knew, at store level, that it was there.
segments.tr: El conjunto fue moldeado en una fábrica, containerizado, enviado a través de un océano, pasó aduanas, estuvo en un centro de distribución regional, viajó en camión a esa tienda, fue escaneado en una estantería — y la aplicación sabía, a nivel de tienda, que estaba allí.

segments.src: That last part is the omnichannel piece.
segments.tr: Esa última parte es la pieza omnicanal.

segments.src: Same price in the aisle and in the app; an employee picks it; and if it's the wrong set, you can return it at the counter even though you "bought it online."
segments.tr: Mismo precio en el pasillo y en la aplicación; un empleado lo recoge; y si es el set incorrecto, puedes devolverlo en el mostrador aunque "lo hayas comprado en línea".

segments.src: The little toy shop has it too, at full price.
segments.tr: La pequeña tienda de juguetes también lo tiene, al precio completo.

segments.src: It can stock a few thousand different items without opening a few thousand supplier accounts, because a distributor bought the pallet and sold it a case of six.
segments.tr: Puede surtirse con algunos miles de artículos diferentes sin abrir algunos miles de cuentas de proveedores, porque un distribuidor compró el pallet y vendió un caso de seis.

segments.src: That's breaking bulk, and it's the entire reason small retail can exist.
segments.tr: Eso es dividir el lote, y es la razón completa por la que la venta minorista pequeña puede existir.

segments.tr: Ahora el lado de la marca del tradeoff, usando números ilustrativos (no los números reales de LEGO):

segments.src: Direct looks like a landslide — until you ask how many people were going to type your URL on a Thursday night.
segments.tr: Lo directo parece una avalancha — hasta que preguntas cuántas personas iban a escribir tu URL el jueves por la noche.

segments.src: Retail costs more than half the margin and delivers something direct can't manufacture: being already there, in the store the customer was going to anyway.
segments.tr: La venta minorista cuesta más de la mitad del margen y entrega algo que lo directo no puede manufacturar: ya estar allí, en la tienda a la que el cliente iba de todas formas.

segments.src: Most brands run both, and spend a lot of effort keeping them from cannibalizing each other.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las marcas ejecutan ambas y gastan mucho esfuerzo manteniéndolas de canibalismo mutuamente.

segments.src: That's the whole discipline in one sentence: **place is the practice of buying availability, and deciding what it's worth.**
segments.tr: Esa es toda la disciplina en una oración: **lugar es la práctica de comprar disponibilidad, y decidir qué vale.**

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen en 3 líneas

segments.src: 1. Place = distribution: the route from maker to user, defined by how many intermediaries are in it and how widely the product is stocked.
segments.tr: 1. Lugar = distribución: la ruta del fabricante al usuario, definida por cuántos intermediarios hay en ella y qué tan ampliamente se distribuye el producto.

segments.src: 2. Intermediaries aren't optional overhead — they perform functions (breaking bulk, inventory risk, credit, assortment, returns) that someone has to perform, so removing them means absorbing them.
segments.tr: 2. Los intermediarios no son gastos generales opcionales — realizan funciones (dividir lote, riesgo de inventario, crédito, surtido, devoluciones) que alguien tiene que realizar, así que eliminarlos significa absorberlos.

segments.src: 3. Omnichannel isn't "selling in many places"; it's channels sharing inventory, price, and customer data so the shopper meets one brand — and adding channels always risks conflict with the ones you already have.
segments.tr: 3. Omnicanal no es "vender en muchos lugares"; es canales compartiendo inventario, precio y datos de clientes para que el comprador encuentre una marca — y agregar canales siempre arriesga conflicto con los que ya tienes.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-prueba

segments.src: **Q1.** A beverage company wants its new sports drink in every gas station, vending machine, and grocery store it can reach.
segments.tr: **P1.** Una empresa de bebidas quiere su nueva bebida deportiva en cada estación de gasolina, máquina expendedora y tienda de abarrotes que pueda alcanzar.

segments.src: Which distribution intensity is this?
segments.tr: ¿Cuál es esta intensidad de distribución?

segments.src: A) Exclusive B) Selective C) Intensive D) Direct-only
segments.tr: A) Exclusiva B) Selectiva C) Intensiva D) Solo directo

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) A company that sells through its website, a mobile app, and physical stores is by definition running an omnichannel strategy.
segments.tr: **P2.** (V/F) Una empresa que vende a través de su sitio web, una aplicación móvil y tiendas físicas definitivamente está ejecutando una estrategia omnicanal.

segments.src: **Q3.** A furniture brand shuts down its wholesale distributor to "cut out the middleman."
segments.tr: **P3.** Una marca de muebles cierra su distribuidor mayorista para "eliminar al intermediario".

segments.src: Which is the most likely consequence?
segments.tr: ¿Cuál es la consecuencia más probable?

segments.src: A) The distribution functions disappear along with the distributor
segments.tr: A) Las funciones de distribución desaparecen junto con el distribuidor

segments.src: B) The brand must now carry inventory, ship to stores, and manage returns itself
segments.tr: B) La marca debe ahora llevar inventario, enviar a tiendas y manejar devoluciones por sí misma

segments.src: C) Retail prices automatically fall by the distributor's full margin
segments.tr: C) Los precios minoristas caen automáticamente por el margen completo del distribuidor

segments.src: D) Channel conflict becomes impossible
segments.tr: D) El conflicto de canal se vuelve imposible

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de hoy

segments.tr: - **Canal de distribución** — el conjunto de organizaciones que mueven un producto del productor al usuario final.

segments.src: - **Intermediary** — a wholesaler, distributor, or retailer that performs channel functions such as breaking bulk, holding inventory, and extending credit.
segments.tr: - **Intermediario** — un mayorista, distribuidor o minorista que realiza funciones de canal como dividir lotes, mantener inventario y extender crédito.

segments.src: - **Distribution intensity** — how many outlets carry the product: intensive (everywhere), selective (a curated set), or exclusive (one per territory).
segments.tr: - **Intensidad de distribución** — cuántos puntos de venta llevan el producto: intensiva (en todas partes), selectiva (un conjunto seleccionado) o exclusiva (uno por territorio).

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — channels integrated to share inventory, pricing, and customer data so the experience feels like one brand, versus multichannel silos.
segments.tr: - **Omnicanal** — canales integrados para compartir inventario, precios y datos de clientes para que la experiencia se sienta como una marca, versus silos multicanal.

segments.src: - **Channel conflict** — friction that arises when a new or existing channel undercuts another, e.g., a brand's direct site competing with its own retail partners.
segments.tr: - **Conflicto de canal** — fricción que surge cuando un canal nuevo o existente subestima otro, por ejemplo, un sitio directo de una marca compitiendo con sus propios socios minoristas.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — C.** Maximum coverage for a low-consideration convenience good; shoppers won't search, so absence equals a lost sale.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: **P1 — C.** Cobertura máxima para un bien de conveniencia de baja consideración; los compradores no buscarán, así que la ausencia equivale a una venta perdida.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** That's multichannel.
segments.tr: **P2 — F (Falso).** Eso es multicanal.

segments.src: It only becomes omnichannel when the channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history — app stock visibility, in-store returns for online orders, and so on.
segments.tr: Solo se convierte en omnicanal cuando los canales comparten inventario, precios e historial de clientes — visibilidad de stock en la aplicación, devoluciones en la tienda para pedidos en línea, etcétera.

segments.src: **Q3 — B.** Channel functions can be shifted, not eliminated; whoever drops out hands the warehousing, shipping, credit, and returns work to someone else — usually the brand.
segments.tr: **P3 — B.** Las funciones de canal pueden ser desplazadas, no eliminadas; quienquiera que se retire entrega el almacenamiento, envío, crédito y trabajo de devoluciones a alguien más — generalmente la marca.

segments.src: Prices don't automatically drop (A and C are the classic misconception), and going direct typically *increases* conflict risk rather than removing it (D).*
segments.tr: Los precios no caen automáticamente (A y C son el malentendido clásico), y pasar a lo directo típicamente *aumenta* el riesgo de conflicto en lugar de eliminarlo (D).*

segments.src: A **direct channel** goes maker → customer: a farmers market stand, a brand's own website, a factory outlet.
segments.tr: تذهب **القناة المباشرة** من المُنتج → العميل: موقف سوق المزارعين، موقع العلامة التجارية الخاص بها، متجر المصنع.

segments.src: An **indirect channel** adds **intermediaries**: manufacturer → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you.
segments.tr: تضيف **القناة غير المباشرة** **الوسطاء**: المُصنِّع → تاجر الجملة/الموزع → بائع التجزئة → أنت.

segments.src: Each hop takes a slice of margin.
segments.tr: كل محطة تأخذ حصة من الهامش.

segments.src: Each hop also does real work.
segments.tr: كل محطة تقوم أيضاً بعمل حقيقي.

segments.src: That's the part people get wrong.
segments.tr: هذا هو الجزء الذي يُخطئ فيه الناس.

segments.src: The common complaint is that middlemen are markup for nothing.
segments.tr: الشكوى الشائعة هي أن الوسطاء علامة تسعير بلا قيمة.

segments.src: But distribution functions can be *shifted*, not *eliminated*.
segments.tr: لكن يمكن *تحويل* وظائف التوزيع، وليس *القضاء عليها*.

segments.src: Somebody has to:
segments.tr: يجب على شخص ما أن:

segments.src: - **Break bulk** — turn a truckload into a shelf's worth
segments.tr: - **تقسيم الجملة** — تحويل شاحنة كاملة إلى ما يملأ رف

segments.src: - **Carry inventory** and absorb the risk that it doesn't sell
segments.tr: - **حمل المخزون** وتحمل مخاطر عدم بيعه

segments.src: - **Extend credit** so a small store can stock before it sells
segments.tr: - **تقديم الائتمان** حتى يمكن للمتجر الصغير تخزين المنتج قبل بيعه

segments.src: - **Assemble assortment** so you don't visit 40 brand websites for one shopping trip
segments.tr: - **جمع التشكيلة** حتى لا تضطر لزيارة 40 موقع علامة تجارية لرحلة تسوق واحدة

segments.src: - **Handle returns**, damage, and customer questions
segments.tr: - **التعامل مع الإرجاعات** والأضرار والأسئلة

segments.src: Cut the distributor and you inherit the warehouse, the trucks, the credit risk, and the returns desk.
segments.tr: قطع الموزع وتوارث المستودع والشاحنات ومخاطر الائتمان ومكتب الإرجاعات.

segments.src: Sometimes that's worth it.
segments.tr: أحياناً يستحق ذلك.

segments.src: It's never free.
segments.tr: لا يكون أبداً مجانياً.

segments.src: How widely?**
segments.tr: ما مدى الانتشار؟**

segments.src: This is **distribution intensity**, and it has three settings:
segments.tr: هذا هو **كثافة التوزيع**، وله ثلاث إعدادات:

segments.src: - **Intensive** — everywhere physically possible. Soda, gum, phone chargers, sunscreen. Nobody drives across town for a Coke; if it isn't there, the sale goes to whatever *is*.
segments.tr: - **كثيفة** — في كل مكان ممكن فيزيائياً. الصودا والعلكة وشواحن الهاتف والكريم الواقي من الشمس. لا أحد يقود السيارة عبر البلدة للحصول على كوكا كولا؛ إذا لم تكن هناك، ستذهب عملية البيع إلى أي منتج *موجود*.

segments.src: - **Selective** — a curated set of partners. Appliances, mid-tier cosmetics, running shoes. Enough coverage to be findable, few enough to keep service quality up.
segments.tr: - **انتقائية** — مجموعة منسقة من الشركاء. الأجهزة الكهربائية والمستحضرات التجميل من الفئة الوسطى والأحذية الرياضية. تغطية كافية لتكون قابلة للعثور عليها، وقليلة بما يكفي للحفاظ على جودة الخدمة.

segments.src: - **Exclusive** — one partner per territory. Luxury watches, car dealerships, high-end audio. Scarcity and service are part of the product.
segments.tr: - **حصرية** — شريك واحد لكل منطقة. الساعات الفاخرة وموزعي السيارات وأنظمة الصوت عالية الجودة. الندرة والخدمة جزء من المنتج.

segments.src: The right setting follows how people shop.
segments.tr: الإعداد الصحيح يتبع كيفية تسوق الناس.

segments.src: The less someone is willing to search, the more intensive you must be.
segments.tr: كلما قل استعداد شخص للبحث، كلما كان عليك أن تكون أكثر كثافة.

segments.src: **Multichannel vs.
segments.tr: **متعدد القنوات مقابل

segments.src: omnichannel.** These get used interchangeably and shouldn't be.
segments.tr: سياق كامل.** يتم استخدام هذه المصطلحات بالتبادل ولا يجب أن تكون كذلك.

segments.src: *Multichannel* means you sell in several places, each running as its own silo — the website has no idea what the store has.
segments.tr: *متعدد القنوات* يعني أنك تبيع في عدة أماكن، كل منها يعمل كصومعة خاصة به — الموقع الإلكتروني لا يعرف ما لديه المتجر.

segments.src: *Omnichannel* means those channels share inventory, pricing, and customer history, so the shopper experiences one brand instead of three departments.
segments.tr: *السياق الكامل* يعني أن تلك القنوات تشارك المخزون والتسعير وسجل العملاء، لذا يختبر المتسوق علامة تجارية واحدة بدلاً من ثلاث أقسام.

segments.src: Buy online / pick up in store, return an online order at the register, ship-from-store, an app that shows real stock at the location nearest you — those are omnichannel plumbing, not marketing copy.
segments.tr: الشراء عبر الإنترنت / الاستلام في المتجر، إرجاع طلب عبر الإنترنت في الكاشير، الشحن من المتجر، تطبيق يُظهر المخزون الفعلي في الموقع الأقرب إليك — هذه هي عمليات السياق الكامل، وليست نصوص تسويقية.

segments.src: **Channel conflict** is the standard failure mode: a new channel eats an existing one.
segments.tr: **تضارب القنوات** هو وضع الفشل القياسي: تستهلك قناة جديدة واحدة موجودة.

segments.src: A brand launches a direct site priced below the retailers who built its shelf presence, and those retailers quietly cut their orders.
segments.tr: تطلق علامة تجارية موقعاً مباشراً بسعر أقل من بائعي التجزئة الذين بنوا وجودها على الرفوف، ويقلل هؤلاء بائعو التجزئة طلباتهم بهدوء.

segments.src: Companies manage this with consistent pricing, channel-specific assortments (the exclusive colorway only Dick's gets), and minimum advertised price policies.
segments.tr: تدير الشركات هذا بالتسعير المتسق، والتشكيلات الخاصة بالقنوات (نمط اللون الحصري الذي تحصل عليه Dick's فقط)، وسياسات الحد الأدنى للسعر المعلن.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: It's Thursday night in Dallas.
segments.tr: إنه ليل الخميس في دالاس.

segments.src: Your kid's birthday party is Saturday and the one thing they asked for is a specific LEGO set.
segments.tr: حفلة عيد ميلاد طفلك يوم السبت والشيء الوحيد الذي طلبوه هو مجموعة LEGO محددة.

segments.src: You have options, and each is a different channel structure.
segments.tr: لديك خيارات، وكل واحدة لها هيكل قناة مختلف.

segments.src: LEGO's own site is **direct**.
segments.tr: موقع LEGO الخاص به **مباشر**.

segments.src: Amazon is a retailer plus a marketplace of third-party sellers.
segments.tr: أمازون هي بائع تجزئة بالإضافة إلى سوق للبائعين من جهات خارجية.

segments.src: Target and Walmart are **retailers** buying at wholesale.
segments.tr: Target و Walmart هما **بائعو تجزئة** يشتريان بسعر الجملة.

segments.src: The independent toy shop two miles away buys through a **distributor**.
segments.tr: متجر الألعاب المستقل على بعد ميلين يشتري من خلال **موزع**.

segments.src: You open the Target app, see that the store off I-35 has one on the shelf, order it, and pick it up in an hour.
segments.tr: تفتح تطبيق Target، ترى أن المتجر بعيداً عن I-35 يوجد واحد على الرف، تطلبه، وتستلمه في ساعة واحدة.

segments.src: Trace what had to happen for that hour to exist.
segments.tr: تتبع ما كان يجب أن يحدث لكي توجد تلك الساعة.

segments.src: The set was molded in a factory, containerized, shipped across an ocean, cleared customs, sat in a regional distribution center, rode a truck to that store, got scanned onto a shelf — and the app knew, at store level, that it was there.
segments.tr: تم تشكيل المجموعة في مصنع، وتم تعبئتها في حاويات، وشحنها عبر محيط، وتم تخليصها الجمركي، وظلت في مركز توزيع إقليمي، وركبت شاحنة إلى ذلك المتجر، وتم فحصها ضوئياً على الرف — والتطبيق كان يعرف، على مستوى المتجر، أنها كانت هناك.

segments.src: That last part is the omnichannel piece.
segments.tr: هذا الجزء الأخير هو جزء السياق الكامل.

segments.src: Same price in the aisle and in the app; an employee picks it; and if it's the wrong set, you can return it at the counter even though you "bought it online."
segments.tr: نفس السعر في الممر وفي التطبيق؛ يلتقطها موظف؛ وإذا كانت مجموعة خاطئة، يمكنك إرجاعها عند الكاشير حتى وإن "اشتريتها عبر الإنترنت."

segments.src: The little toy shop has it too, at full price.
segments.tr: متجر الألعاب الصغير لديه واحد أيضاً، بالسعر الكامل.

segments.src: It can stock a few thousand different items without opening a few thousand supplier accounts, because a distributor bought the pallet and sold it a case of six.
segments.tr: يمكنه تخزين عدة آلاف من العناصر المختلفة دون فتح عدة آلاف من حسابات الموردين، لأن موزعاً اشترى المنصة وباعها صندوقاً من ستة.

segments.src: That's breaking bulk, and it's the entire reason small retail can exist.
segments.tr: هذا هو تقسيم الجملة، وهو السبب الكامل لوجود بيع التجزئة الصغيرة.
